# ZET — Retirement Announcement

After a lot of thought, I’ve decided to officially retire from **ZET and Roblox**.

I’m stepping away from gang leadership and Roblox completely. I’ve had a lot of great memories with ZET, met some amazing people, and experienced a lot during my time here.

I want to thank everyone who supported me, supported ZET, and was part of the journey. I genuinely appreciate all the memories and everything we built together.

**Zeus and the rest of the ZET leadership will continue handling the gang from here.**

I’m not leaving Discord, so you can still reach me here. I’m just stepping away from Roblox and everything related to it.

Thank you for everything.

**ZET forever.**

— **Fisty** || @everyone Maybe Come Back Or Never ||
